nodes.label: Performance Benchmark Framework & 10-minute ISR
nodes.rationale: 67-endpoint benchmark showed the Hetzner VPS 2x-4.8x faster TTFB than Vercel for DB-driven pages (Song Detail 93ms vs 258ms); revalidate=600 ISR on home and /songs plus Traefik Cache-Control max-age=600; HTML report generator persists timestamped JSON history.

nodes.label: Programmatic Random Seeder (scripts/random-seeder.mjs)
nodes.rationale: Generates 80 ChordPro songs, taxonomy mappings and 5 playlists for E2E. Client-side sequential inserts (~480 queries) took 70s over Tailscale, so it was rewritten as a single database-side PL/pgSQL DO block (<0.2s); ORDER BY random() on unnest() was optimized away by the planner so direct table queries are used; Box-Muller distribution for tags per song and forced 100% subcategory coverage; also seeds rehearsal takes (50% multi, 30% single, 20% none).

nodes.label: Private Rehearsal Audio Recording (Story 4.6.1)
nodes.rationale: Private 'rehearsals' storage bucket with owner-only RLS (auth.uid() = foldername) and user_recordings metadata table; AudioRecorder uses MediaRecorder with webm->mp4 fallback, 3-minute cap and 10MB client/bucket limit; signed URLs (1h) for playback; RehearsalDrawer degrades gracefully with 'Missing File' badge when storage objects are orphaned; 3-second countdown warms the mic to avoid hardware pop.

nodes.label: Role System (Guest/Member/Expert/Admin/Gatekeeper)
nodes.rationale: Generic 'User' refactored to strict 'Member'; 'Moderator' renamed 'Musician' then 'Expert' to better reflect the domain. Later decided (Feb 28 2026) to remove 'musician' as a role entirely and replace it with a self-declared is_musician boolean on profiles (no admin approval). Gatekeeper role added July 2026 for curating public playlists.

nodes.label: Row Level Security (RLS) Hardening
nodes.rationale: RLS enabled on setlists, setlist_items, compositions, profiles. Policies were relaxed to allow public inserts so Mock Mode (anonymous) users could add songs; a SECURITY DEFINER helper was introduced for song_category_map to resolve policy recursion on staging. Server-side RLS is the primary security layer, which is why no REST API layer was deemed necessary.

nodes.label: Seed Architecture & Deterministic Visibility
nodes.rationale: Local test data lives in seed.sql / supabase/seeds and only loads locally. Randomized ownership/visibility was removed in favour of deterministic seeds: 42 initial songs private (Member), 179 Nina Urku songs public (Expert) to keep counts consistent across environments (221 total).

nodes.label: Server Components over API Routes (PR #74)
nodes.rationale: Decided against a REST API layer: Server Components + Server Actions with direct Supabase SDK calls under RLS is the correct App Router pattern; API routes would add boilerplate without security or decoupling benefit. lib/songs/serverQueries.ts mirrors client query logic with the server client factory; pages pre-fetch and pass initialData to React Query, eliminating skeleton flash and improving SEO.

nodes.label: Same-origin /supabase-api Proxy
nodes.rationale: Client builds the Supabase URL as window.location.origin + /supabase-api so requests stay same-origin while satisfying the SDK's absolute-URL validation; next.config rewrites map to the internal Docker Kong hostname; later replaced by a runtime route handler app/supabase-api/[...path]/route.ts because standalone builds cannot read env vars at build time for rewrites.

nodes.label: Supabase on Tailscale Private Network
nodes.rationale: Kong gateway published only on the Tailscale interface with public Traefik routing disabled, avoiding Let's Encrypt renewal warnings and exposure of the database API.

nodes.label: Unified Audio Experience: useAudio, MiniPlayer, nowPlaying (#237)
nodes.norm_label: unified audio experience: useaudio, miniplayer, nowplaying (#237)

Built by 3 parallel subagents on isolated branches. Drawer tabs use CSS visibility instead of conditional mounting so switching tabs does not kill YouTube/SoundCloud playback. Orange theme for reference tracks, indigo for user recordings.

nodes.label: useAuth Timeout & Skeleton Hang Fix (#181)
nodes.rationale: Slow Supabase Auth (Tailscale / cold start) hung song detail on a skeleton forever; getUser() and profile fetch wrapped in a 5s Promise.race falling back to guest; mounted flag replaced by cancellation token; 10s skeleton timer swaps to a Retry UI; withTimeout wraps detail fetches (4.5s prod, 15s local).

nodes.label: Bottom-up Remediation Approach
nodes.rationale: Fix foundations first (config, shared queries, validation) and build upward so each step is an independently shippable small PR: quick wins > DRY queries > Zod > component extraction > infinite scroll > tests.

nodes.label: Infinite Scroll with Cursor Pagination

nodes.label: staleTime Tuning
nodes.rationale: Per-query staleTime instead of a global 5-minute default: lists 1 min (refresh often), details/taxonomy 5 min (rarely change).

nodes.label: Zod Validation on Server Actions
nodes.rationale: Server actions accepted raw strings; malformed input caused unnecessary DB round-trips. Reusable Zod atoms (uuid, playlistTitle, playlistDescription) are parsed at the top of each action, errors returned as { error }.

nodes.label: Home Screen (Sacred Fire Songs)
nodes.description: Mobile-width dashboard screenshot of the Sacred Fire Songs web app in dark mode. Vertically stacked: top app bar, 'Your Library' stat cards, 'Explore by Category' card grid, and a fixed bottom tab bar. Purpose: give a logged-in user quick access to their personal library counts and a category-driven entry point into the song catalog.
nodes.rationale: Home acts as a personalized landing hub rather than a plain song list: personal stats (favorites, drafts, my songs, new songs) are placed first so returning users see their own material, while category exploration serves discovery of the community catalog.

nodes.label: Dark Theme Visual Design
nodes.description: Near-black background, dark gray cards with subtle borders, white text, muted gray section labels, saturated accent colors per icon; a moon icon in the app bar indicates a theme toggle.
nodes.rationale: Dark UI suits low-light ceremonial/fire-circle contexts where the app is used to read songs; a user-selectable theme toggle is exposed in the header.

nodes.label: Library Stat Card
nodes.description: Reusable card pattern: left colored rounded-square icon badge, large bold count number, small muted caption label underneath. Color-coded per metric (pink favorites, amber drafts, blue my songs, teal new songs).
nodes.rationale: Color coding and large numerals let users scan their personal library status at a glance; the tinted border ties each card to its icon color for faster recognition.

nodes.label: Explore by Category Section

nodes.rationale: Preferred over next-intl/react-i18next because: (1) a pure TypeScript t() function with zero React hooks works in Server Components, Client Components, API routes and utilities without forcing 'use client'; (2) minimal bundle size and complexity by skipping middleware/URL-rewrite locale routing, rendering a default language on the server and swapping to the localStorage preference client-side post-hydration; (3) native type safety since t() lives next to the dictionary files and TypeScript infers every valid key.
